description: Na₄CdZn(SiO₃)₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.57 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.56 Å. Cd is bonded to four O atoms to form CdO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.18 Å) and two longer (2.19 Å) Cd-O bond lengths. Zn is bonded to four O atoms to form ZnO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.96 Å) and two longer (1.99 Å) Zn-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ZnO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.62 Å) and two longer (1.69 Å) Si-O bond lengths. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CdO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.69 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Cd, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Na and two Si atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂Si₂ trigonal pyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Zn, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂ZnSi trigonal pyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Cd, and one Si atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂CdSi trigonal pyramids.
